Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production 2D fighting-game sprite atlas, square 1024 by 1024, genuinely transparent RGBA background.
Style: classic early-2000s Little Fighter 2 game look: compact anime arcade sprite, large expressive head, approximately 3-head-tall body, crisp dark pixel outlines, restrained 3-tone cel shading, readable silhouette at 80 pixels tall. Hand-pixelled low-resolution appearance, NOT 3D, not photorealistic.
Layout: EXACTLY four equal columns and four equal rows, 16 equal 256x256 tiles. Each tile contains ONE complete full-body drawing of the SAME character, facing right in side/three-quarter game view. Consistent identity, outfit and scale, approximately 170 pixels high, feet on tile-local y=220, centered at x=128. Keep every drawing entirely inside its tile with ample transparent margin. No dividing grid, no labels, no letters, no title, no background scene, no ground shadow.
Read left to right, top to bottom:
row 1: neutral combat idle; walk left leg forward; walk right leg forward; running forward.
row 2: straight punch; extended high kick; braced blocking; upward jump with knees tucked.
row 3: taking a hit and recoiling; knocked down lying sideways; signature ranged attack pose; signature rushing attack pose.
row 4: overhead special attack pose; powerful ultimate attack pose; crouched landing; victorious stance.
Create precise distinct action silhouettes. Energy effects stay compact near the hand or weapon, never cover the character or adjacent tiles.
Character: Marvel Iron Man, iconic red and gold armored suit, gold faceplate with white eye slits, cyan circular arc reactor in chest. Armor remains compact and cute but heroic. Ranged pose thrusts palm forward with a small cyan repulsor glow. Rushing pose leans forward with boot jets. Overhead pose aims upward; ultimate pose spreads both palms with bright chest reactor. No text.

Classic winged silver helmet, blond hair, red cape, dark torso armor with six round silver discs, blue trousers, yellow boots, and compact gray Mjolnir held at rest. Use a neatly spaced 2 by 2 arrangement on a genuinely transparent background. All feet, cape tips, helmet wings and hammer must be entirely visible with generous margin. No other characters, no text, no labels, no logo, no scenery, no shadow floor. Pixel-game design reference, not a film still or realistic human.
